pooyan.description: Mama pig rides a gondola up and down a cliff, shooting arrows at the wolves that float down on balloons to protect her piglets.

scobra.description: Fly a helicopter through enemy territory, shooting and bombing targets while keeping an eye on the fuel.

tutankhm.description: Explore the pharaoh's tomb, a maze full of creatures, collecting keys and treasures and shooting left and right.

amidar.description: Trace the lines of an amidakuji-style grid, painting its edges and filling boxes while avoiding the enemies.

digdug.description: Dig tunnels underground and defeat the Pookas and Fygars by inflating them or dropping rocks on them.

warpwarp.description: Fight the Berobero aliens in open space and inside the warp maze, where you use bombs instead of shots.

turpin.description: Guide a turtle through a maze, carrying the baby turtles home while escaping the beetles.

fightbug.description: Guide a ladybug through a maze with revolving gates, eating the dots and avoiding the insects.

spcpanic.description: Climb ladders between platforms and dig holes to trap the aliens, then bury them before they climb out.

naugtboy.description: A boy throws rocks at the monsters and tries to destroy their fortress.

antiair.description: Destroy all the UFOs while dodging the falling bombs and blocks. Your shots can't break the blocks, but enemy bombs make them disappear.

ascend.description: Reach the top floor while avoiding the monsters. Jump to push blocks up and trap the monsters.

awass.description: Collect all the flags. You can scroll the floors to reconnect the ladders.

battlot.description: Destroy the enemy base. The game is over if your own base is destroyed three times.

bootskell.description: Push blocks into the monsters to defeat them. Watch out: the monsters push blocks at you too.

cacorm.description: Draw lines to enclose the stars and make them vanish. Clear all the stars to finish the stage.

cavit.description: Collect all the treasure chests. Drop rocks to defeat the monsters.

cracky.description: Collect all the stars. Cracked floors vanish once you walk over them, so each can be crossed only once.

demonios.description: An illustrated text adventure based on the 1893 short story by the Brazilian writer Aluísio Azevedo.
demonios.notes: Published in English, Portuguese and Spanish, each in its own ROM.

hopman.description: Reach the goal at the right edge. You don't need to collect all the flags.

lift.description: Collect all the flags while avoiding the monsters. Ride the lifts to reach the upper floors.

mazy.description: Find the exit somewhere in the maze. Pick up knives and throw them at the monsters in your way.

mazy2.description: Find the exit somewhere in the maze. Pick up knives and throw them at the monsters in your way.

mieyen.description: Defeat all the invisible monsters. The breadcrumbs they eat disappear, which gives away where they are.

neuras.description: Pick up cards and throw them; lining up cards with the same number makes them disappear. Clear all the cards.

osotos.description: Collect all the stars. Hit the monsters with blocks to defeat them.

control_test.description: Test ROM by Péricles S.: each button of both controllers lights up while it is held, with a different beep for each controller; the raw joystick matrix and a frame counter are shown. Source: github.com/PSGM-Romhacking/pv-1000_control_test_rom.

pvong.description: 2-player Pong by joe_k, with the ball moved pixel by pixel through patterns in RAM and music by the pvbanjo driver. MIT license. Source: github.com/joffb/pvong.

ruptus.description: Destroy all the enemy bases. A blocking barrier disappears when you destroy either of its ends.

simon.description: The Simon memory game (1978), by KashtPR: repeat the color sequence with the directions (up green, down blue, left yellow, right red), for 1 or 2 players. Written in C with z88dk; posted on the NESdev forum.

svellas.description: Follow the paths on the rows of panels and collect all the stars. Moving the panels reconnects the paths and lets you cross between separate panels.

swordwrk.description: Collect all the treasure chests. Picking up items extends your attack range.

uchotos.description: Collect all the stars. You can walk across monsters you have shot down.

yewdow.description: Place arrows to steer the car through all the flags. You fail if the car leaves the screen or hits a rock.
